data.narrative:
VVater, a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Kevin Gast, has raised $5.79M to date. The broader sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within Climate & Energy to support a reliable peer-median valuation method—no narrow cohort yielded three or more datapoints.

Accordingly, stage-progression analysis provides the primary triangulation input. Using total capital raised ($5.79M, rounded to $6M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $14M. This method is applicable given the company's current stage positioning and recent fundraising activity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $12M to $17M, with a median point of $14M. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression midpoint in the absence of peer-derived anchors. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-cohort comparables in Climate & Energy, reliance on a single methodological input, and the opaque current post-money valuation from the most recent round. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending access to recent round documentation or emergence of closer-stage peer transactions.
